cards.text: Israel's on the road through the wilderness. The whole congregation sets out from Kadesh and comes to Mount Hor. A WHOLE nation on the move, friend, and I spent years unable to get out of one junk drawer.

cards.question: Mount Hor sits right near the border of another land. Which one?

cards.text: There at Mount Hor, the LORD speaks to Moses, Israel's leader, and Aaron, Israel's priest. God says Aaron will be gathered to his people, and I think that whole conversation got real quiet.

cards.question: God tells Moses and Aaron that Aaron will enter the land He has given the Israelites.

cards.text: God doesn't leave Aaron guessing why. The reason is the waters of Meribah, earlier in this same chapter, where God gave Moses and Aaron a command about bringing water out of a rock.

cards.question: God says Aaron was the only one at fault at the waters of Meribah.
God says both Moses and Aaron did something at the waters of Meribah. What was it?

cards.text: Then God gives Moses the plan: take Aaron up Mount Hor, and bring one of Aaron's sons along too. Three men, one mountain, and I bet nobody's talking about the view.

cards.question: God tells Moses to take Aaron and his son ___ up Mount Hor.
Up on Mount Hor, God tells Moses to take something off Aaron the priest and put it on Eleazar. What is it?

cards.text: God says it plainly: Aaron will die there. And Moses does as the LORD commanded. I bet that was the longest climb of his life.
Meanwhile, remember who else came to Mount Hor. The whole congregation is right there at the foot of that mountain.

cards.question: Moses, Aaron and Eleazar climb Mount Hor where nobody can see them.

cards.text: At the top, Moses removes Aaron's garments and puts them on Eleazar. Then Aaron dies there on top of the mountain, with Moses and his son right beside him.

cards.question: After Aaron dies on top of Mount Hor, who comes back down the mountain?

cards.text: Down below, the whole congregation sees that Aaron has died, and the entire house of Israel mourns for him. That's a whole people with one heavy heart, friend.

cards.question: The entire house of Israel mourns for Aaron for ___ days.

findings.problem: Card 12 retells Numbers 20:22 (the whole congregation came to Mount Hor), which card 1 already told. It is a recap that doesn't move the passage forward. Its only job is to tee up card 13, and that setup belongs on a card that tells verse 27.

rule.text: Every story card moves the baker forward through the passage.

findings.problem: Card 12 is a recap card. It looks back to verse 22 instead of telling a new piece of the passage.

This fill in the blank asks for Eleazar's name, which the baker hasn't seen and can't reason out from earlier cards. Card 8 only says 'one of Aaron's sons.' The blank tests unseen wording, so it is a pure guess. It could be a multiple choice discovery question instead, or the blank could test something the baker can reason out.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

findings.problem: This fill in the blank asks for the number of mourning days (thirty), which nothing earlier sets up. The baker can only guess between thirty, seven and forty. The blank tests a detail they haven't seen, not meaning they can reason out.
